title: Extreme Engineering Recalls Wall Climbing Cable Assemblies Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The cable eye, or round metal tube that holds the cable, could have a fracture, reducing the overall strength of the cable assembly. If the cable assembly were to fail, this would result in a free-fall hazard for the climber. Units: About 400.

title: Safety Alert: Robert Bosch Tool Corp. Abrasive Cut-Off Wheels Lack Safety Warning Label
summary: The Abrasive Cut-Off Wheel packages are not properly labeled with precautionary information on proper use and operation. The failure of a user to follow the instructions below could result in injury. "! WARNING Read, understand and comply with tool manual before use. Follow OSHA and ANSI B7.1 standa

title: Safety Alert: Robert Bosch Tool Corp. Masonry Drill Bits Lack Safety Warning Label
summary: The drill bit packages are not properly labeled with precautionary information on proper use and operation. These and other manufacturers' 13-inch bits can bend when run at a high speed without being in contact with a work surface, resulting in loss of control of the drill and possible lacerations.

title: Full-Body Safety Harnesses Recalled for Fall Hazard
summary: The harnesses could fail during use, resulting in consumers falling from tree stands and suffering serious injuries or death. Units: About 106,000.

title: Petters Consumer Brands, LLC Recalls Sunbeam Gas Ranges after Two Incidents of Scorched Floors
summary: These ranges lack an adequate heat shield, and can cause scorching of certain flooring materials directly under the appliance. Units: About 3,600.

title: Ruby's Diner Inc. Recalls Giveaway Yo-Yo Toy for Choking Hazard
summary: The yo-yo can separate and expose small parts. This presents a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 200,000.

title: Endurance Treadmills Recalled for Unexpected Speed Changes Posing Fall Hazard
summary: The treadmill can unexpectedly accelerate or decelerate, possibly causing the user to lose control and fall. Units: About 700.

title: Etón Portable Radios Recalled, Batteries Pose Fire Hazard
summary: The battery in this radio can overheat and possibly rupture when using the AC adapter, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,700.

title: Fitness Quest Gazelle Freestyle Crosstrainers and Crosstrainer Pro Gliders Recalled for Fall Hazard
summary: The resistance pistons on the glider can come off during exercise. If this happens, a person using the glider can fall off the exercise machine. Units: About 154,000.

title: Scubapro® X650 Diving Regulators Recalled for Drowning Hazard
summary: A manufacturing error could cause the main housing of some regulators to change shape over time, which could cause the cover and diaphragm to become dislodged. If this occurs, air flow will be interrupted and the regulators will no longer function, posing a drowning hazard to users. Units: About 670

title: Applica Consumer Products Inc. Recalls Black & Decker® Brand Coffeemaker for Fire Hazard
summary: The coffeemaker may not turn off as programmed, causing the unit to overheat and melt, and posing a risk of fire and burn injury. Units: About 420,000.

title: Hewlett-Packard Company Recalls Digital Cameras Due to Fire Hazard, Offers Download Fix
summary: The digital camera can cause certain non-rechargeable batteries, such as the Duracell CP-1, to overheat when the camera is connected to an AC adapter or docking station, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 224,000 (about 679,000 worldwide).

title: LTD Commodities LLC Recalls Ficus Trees Sold with Lights for Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The lights attached to the ficus tree have undersized and exposed wires, which pose a risk of electric shock and fire hazards. Units: About 2,500.

title: Nexgrill Industries Gas Grills Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The gas grill has a hose that connects the propane tank to the burner manifold. If this hose runs up too close to the firebox, the heat can cause the hose to detach from the burner manifold, causing a gas leak and a fire hazard. Units: About 16,000.

title: Adjmi Apparel Group Recalls Reebok Children's Windsuits for Choking Hazard
summary: The Reebok logo appliqué on the clear rubber zipper pull on the jacket can detach, posing a choking or aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 55,000.

title: Oceanic Recalls Digital Dive Computer Due to Decompression Hazard
summary: When using the dive computer set for "User Selected Digital Gauge Mode," the "Elapsed Dive Time" displayed can exceed the actual elapsed time under water. This can cause divers to ascend before fulfilling a decompression obligation, resulting in decompression sickness. Units: About 6,100.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Inc. Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle's stem has a magnesium faceplate that holds the handlebar in place. The faceplates on the recalled stems can crack, allowing the handlebar to break off the bicycle, posing a serious fall hazard. Units: About 2,700.

title: American Suzuki Motor Corp. Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles for Crash Hazard
summary: The cushion lever mounting bracket on the ATV frame can break. If this occurs, the rider could lose control of the ATV and crash, posing a risk of serious injury or death. Units: About 6,300.

title: BJ Alan Co. Recalls "Thunderstick Rocket" Fireworks for Explosion Hazard
summary: These rockets are overloaded with flash powder, violating the regulatory standard for this product. During use, these fireworks could explode with a greater force than expected and cause burns and bodily harm to nearby consumers. Units: About 61,200 packages of six rockets.

title: Phil Vassil Rugs Recalls Flokati Rugs for Fire Hazard
summary: These rugs fail to meet the federal mandatory standard for flammability under the Flammable Fabrics Act and could ignite, presenting a risk of burn injuries. Units: 55 (About 18 were sold to consumers).

title: Children's Cloth Books Recalled by Simon & Schuster
summary: The felt ears and limbs on the pop-up characters can detach or come apart when pulled, which may pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 9,000.

title: Nine West Footwear Corporation Recalls Sandals for Laceration Hazard
summary: The sandals' metal tacks, which help to hold down the sides of the strap to the sole, can detach or be pulled out, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 6,700 pairs.

title: ValueVision Media Inc. Recalls Torchiere Lamps for Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical problem can cause the torchiere lamps to spark, smoke or burn, posing a fire or burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,200.

title: Electronic Pressure Cookers Sold by QVC Recalled Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The lid on these pressure cookers can open prematurely while contents are under pressure, and hot contents can be expelled, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 900.

title: Foldable Steel Hammock Stand Sold at Lowe's Stores Recalled
summary: The welds attaching the arms to the frame of the hammock stand can fail, allowing the hammock to fall. Users can be injured from falling to the ground, striking the hammock stand's base, or being struck by the arms of the hammock stand. Units: About 1,000.

title: H&M Announces Recall of Girls' Water Shoes for Fall Hazard
summary: Though these shoes are marketed for use around water for traction, they become extremely slippery when wet. This poses a risk of slipping and falling on smooth, hard surfaces, such as tile. Units: About 1,900.

title: Herrington Swivel Rockers Sold at Lowe's Stores Recalled for Fall Hazard
summary: The recalled swivel rockers can be assembled incorrectly, causing them to break at the base or tip over backward easily. This poses a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,100.

title: Vision Fitness Recalls Treadmill Console to Repair Unexpected Acceleration Hazard
summary: Due to a programming defect with the console, the treadmill can unexpectedly increase in speed and elevation when the User Programs 4 or 5 are set for longer than 30 minutes. If this happens, the user could fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 480.

title: Electronic Toy Guitars Recalled, Small Parts Pose Choking Hazard
summary: The toy guitar can break into small parts, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 500.

title: Safety Alert: Porter-Cable Cordless Nailer Poses Puncture Hazard
summary: The nailer can eject a nail while the switch is in the "off" position, if the trigger is pulled and it is placed on a surface. This can pose a serious injury to consumers or bystanders. Units: About 25,000.

title: CFM Corp. Recalls Sequoia Wood Burning Fireplaces for Fire Hazard
summary: Due to insufficient insulation or a missing weld, some of these fireplaces could pose a fire hazard. Units: About 1,300.

title: The Swiss Colony Recalls Money Bag Candles for Fire Hazard
summary: The decorations on the candle can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Also, excessive pooling of wax from the burning candles poses a burn hazard. Units: About 65,500.
